findings.label: Stale lint snapshot
findings.detail: The plan's recorded lint evidence lists three unused-symbol warnings for transparency helpers (getTransparencyData, toTransparencyEmbed, detectProvince) that the final working tree now actually wires into the transparency intent branch. The snapshot predates the final state; the M5 code introduces no warnings. No action required for M5.

findings.label: Chat embed uses fixed seed
findings.detail: The chat agri embed derives from DEMO_ADVISORY_INPUT, not the user's live location, so chat planting/spray text is deterministic rather than location-accurate. Documented demo tradeoff; the live /api/agriculture route and AgriculturePanel use real Open-Meteo weather.
